}

    raise SystemExit(f"{mode} repetitions must be an integer from 1 to {maximum}")

                        env=environment, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)

    raise SystemExit("Native replay fixture did not select exactly one test")
command += [selected, "--exact", "--nocapture", "--test-threads=1"]
